## Umbral Dragon, Very Old (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
 CE Gargantuan dragon (extraplanar)  
 **Init** +3; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +32; **Aura** frightful presence (270 ft., DC 27)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 35, touch 5, flat-footed 35 (-1 Dex, +30 natural, -4 size)  
 **hp** 414 (23d12+138)  
 **Fort** +19, **Ref** +12, **Will** +19  
 **DR** 15/magic; **Immune** cold, death effects, negative energy, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 29  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)  
 **Melee** bite +30 (4d6+16/19–20), 2 claws +30 (2d8+11),tail slap +28 (2d8+16) and 2 wings +28 (2d6+5)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 18d8 neg. energy, DC 27), crush (4d6+16, DC 27), shadow breath (9 Str), tail sweep (2d6+16, DC 27)  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 23rd; concentration +29)  

 At will—*[darkness](../../magic/spells/darkness.md)*, *[project image](../../magic/spells/project-image.md)* (DC 23), *[shadow walk](../../magic/spells/shadow-walk.md)*, *[vampiric touch](../../magic/spells/vampiric-touch.md)*  

 **Spells Known** (CL 13th; concentration +19)  

 6th (5/day)—*[harm](../../magic/spells/harm.md)* (DC 22), *[veil](../../magic/spells/veil.md)* (DC 22)  
5th (7/day)—*[greater command](../../magic/spells/command-greater.md)* (DC 21), *[slay living](../../magic/spells/slay-living.md)* (DC 21), *[unhallow](../../magic/spells/unhallow.md)*  
4th (7/day)—*[enervation](../../magic/spells/enervation.md)*, *[inflict critical wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-critical-wounds.md)* (DC 20), *[phantasmal killer](../../magic/spells/phantasmal-killer.md)* (DC 20), *[unholy blight](../../magic/spells/unholy-blight.md)* (DC 20)  
3rd (7/day)—*[dispel magic](../../magic/spells/dispel-magic.md)*, *[haste](../../magic/spells/haste.md)*, *[inflict serious wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-serious-wounds.md)* (DC 19), *[lightning bolt](../../magic/spells/lightning-bolt.md)* (DC 19)  
2nd (8/day)—*[alter self](../../magic/spells/alter-self.md)*, *[blur](../../magic/spells/blur.md)*, *[command undead](../../magic/spells/command-undead.md)* (DC 18), *[invisibility](../../magic/spells/invisibility.md)*, *[web](../../magic/spells/web.md)* (DC 18)  
1st (8/day)—*[inflict light wounds](../../magic/spells/inflict-light-wounds.md)* (DC 17), *[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 17), *[magic missile](../../magic/spells/magic-missile.md)*, *[reduce person](../../magic/spells/reduce-person.md)* (DC 17), *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*  
0 (at will)—*[acid splash](../../magic/spells/acid-splash.md)*, *[bleed](../../magic/spells/bleed.md)* (DC 16), *[detect magic](../../magic/spells/detect-magic.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[disrupt undead](../../magic/spells/disrupt-undead.md)* (DC 16), *[ghost sound](../../magic/spells/ghost-sound.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[ray of frost](../../magic/spells/ray-of-frost.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 33, **Dex** 8, **Con** 23, **Int** 22, **Wis** 23, **Cha** 22  
 **Base Atk** +23; **CMB** +38; **CMD** 47 (51 vs trip)  
 **Feats** Bleeding Critical, Critical Focus, Flyby Attack, Hover, Improved Critical
